dsh-modern-web-guidance
Google Chrome's Modern Web Guidance, offline,
as a DeepSeek Harness plugin.
193 Baseline-aware guides · 3 tools · 2 skills · zero dependencies · local counters only

English ·
Русский ·
中文
Coding models default to legacy web patterns because that is what their training data contains. This

plugin puts 193
curated, token-efficient guides in front of the agent, plus an offline search tool,

so it reaches for the current
platform API (native `<dialog>`/popover, anchor positioning, containe

r queries, view transitions, scroll-driven
effects, `:has()`, passkeys, `fetchpriority`, …) instead
of a JavaScript workaround or a library.
Everything runs locally: the guides ship inside the package, search is computed in-process, and ther

e are no network
calls. Usage counters do exist in 0.2.0, but they never leave the machine — see Usa

network
calls. Usage counters do exist in 0.2.0, but they never leave the machine — see Usage stats.
## What you get
| Kind | Name | Description |
| Tool | `web_guidance_search` | Ranked guide ids for a 2–5 word capability query, optional category

filter |
| Tool | `web_guidance_retrieve` | Full markdown for one or more guide ids (max 10 guides

/ 120k characters per call) |
| Tool | `web_guidance_list` | Catalog overview: counts per category,

or ids/titles for one category |
| Skill | `modern-web-guidance` | The workflow: search → retrieve →

implement → verify → disclose |
| Skill | `chrome-extensions` | Manifest V3 engineering and Chrome
Web Store submission guidance |
The catalog covers `css`, `ui-atoms`, `ui-components`, `ui-behaviors`, `forms`, `html`, `js`, `acces

sibility`,
`visual-design`, `security`, `performance`, `built-in-ai`, `pwa`, `wasm`, `webmcp`, `priv
acy`, and `user-experience`.

From an agent session, `plugin_manager` with `action: "install_bundle"` and the absolute package dir

ectory as `target`
does the same thing. The bundle inserts one row (`modern-web-guidance`) and needs

no build step, no dependencies, and no
native modules.
## How to use
Nothing has to be wired up: the plugin registers itself, and the `modern-web-guidance` skill tells t

he agent when to
reach for it. There are three ways to work with it.
### 1. Just ask for web work (default)
The skill's routing description is "search 193 use-case guides before writing HTML, CSS or client-si

de JavaScript", so
a normal request is enough — the agent searches, retrieves what it needs, and wri

tes code against the current platform
API instead of a workaround:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
### 2. Ask for it explicitly
Use this when you want the guarantee, or when the agent skipped the lookup on a task that clearly de
en you want the guarantee, or when the agent skipped the lookup on a task that clearly deserves one:

- "check the modern web guidance for how this is done today"
- "look it up in the guides before writ

ing that CSS"
- "verify this is Baseline, and show me the fallback"
- "find the guide for light-dism
iss dialogs and follow it"
### 3. Browse the catalog yourself
`web_guidance_list` answers "what is even in here" without spending a retrieval:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Category filters are forgiving (`" CSS "` and `"Css"` mean `css`), and a misspelled category returns

the list of real
ones instead of an empty result.
### Typical tasks
| You want | Query the agent can use | Guide it lands on |

| A modal that closes on backdrop click | `light dismiss dialog` | `light-dismiss-a-dialog` |
| Keep
the page from scrolling under a modal | `prevent page scroll under modal` | `prevent-page-scroll-un

der-modal-dialog` |
| A table that works on a phone | `responsive data table` | `responsive-table` |

| Light/dark theme switching | `dark mode toggle` | `dark-mode-toggle` |
[该节后续省略]
## Security and limits
The corpus is third-party text that ends up in a model's context, and tool arguments come from that

model, so both
sides are bounded:
- **No network, no execution, one local write.** The plugin imports only local `node:fs`, `node:path

` and `node:url`; it
has no dependencies and no lifecycle scripts, so nothing is fetched or run at i

nstall time. The only file it writes is
its own counters file (see Usage stats).
- **Guides cannot s

muggle commands.** Upstream's guide bodies cross-reference each other with
`npx -y modern-web-guidan

ce@latest retrieve "…"` (121 occurrences in 45 guides). Those references are rewritten to
`web_guida
nce_retrieve({"ids":["…"]})` when the index loads, so nothing a model reads from the catalog asks it

to
install and execute an unpinned remote package. The files on disk stay byte-identical to the pin

ned snapshot.
- **`web_guidance_retrieve` is bounded**: at most 10 guides and 120 000 characters per

call, duplicate ids collapse, the
unknown-id echo stops at 10, and the renderer says explicitly wha

t was not returned and to request it separately.
Retrieving all 193 guides used to hand back 1.5 MB

(~450k tokens) in one result.
- **`web_guidance_search` is bounded**: the query is capped at 512 cha

racters and 24 distinct terms before the lexical
scan. A 137 KB query used to block the host's event

loop for seconds; the same shape now costs milliseconds.
- **The catalog cannot reach outside the p

ackage**: entry ids and categories must be slugs, and every resolved path is
checked to stay inside

the data directory. A tampered `guides.json` used to be able to read any `*.md` on disk.
- **Failure
s retry and stay opaque**: a transient read error no longer poisons the tool for the session, and to

ol errors
no longer disclose absolute install paths.
Both properties are covered by `test/hardening.test.mjs`, which fails on the pre-hardening code. The

full audit — three
reports plus runnable repros — lives in `audit/`, and the repro scripts under `a

udit/repro/` exit non-zero
while a defect is live.
